candidate.name: intraday_bipower_jump_variation_share_238m
candidate.mechanism: Nonnegative share of fixed-session minute quadratic variation not explained by within-half adjacent absolute-return bipower variation
candidate.formula: With 238 within-half log-close returns and 236 allowed adjacent pairs, RV=sum r_i^2, BV=(pi/2)*(238/236)*sum |r_i|*|r_{i+1}|, and score=max(RV-BV,0)/RV.
candidate.zero_rule: Exact zero returns remain in RV and all incident bipower products as zeros. Require all returns and pairs and strictly positive finite RV; use no epsilon, dropped pair, smoothing, winsorization, or searched threshold.
candidate.fixed_grid: Exactly 240 closes at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00; exclude required raw 09:30 and never join the lunch boundary.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_realized_volatility
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both use the same 238 within-half log-close returns and RV
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Realized volatility retains only RV level. Campaign088 is homogeneous of degree zero and compares RV with adjacent bipower variation to estimate a discontinuous share.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_diffusive_variation_ratio_238m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both normalize a return-path variation quantity
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal ratio contrasts path displacement or diffusive aggregation with realized variation, whereas Campaign088 uses no net displacement and subtracts an adjacent absolute-product estimator from RV.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_volatility_resolution_238m and intraday_five_minute_variance_ratio_230w
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: all distinguish forms of variation beyond one raw RV level
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Those compare fixed sampling resolutions or coarse aggregation. Campaign088 stays on the one-minute grid and uses bipower products, with no five-minute return or scale choice.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_absolute_return_serial_persistence_236p
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Serial persistence is a centered Pearson correlation with marginal variance normalization. Campaign088 uses the uncentered bipower sum with the fixed pi/2 correction and normalizes against RV to estimate a jump share.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_return_reversal_energy_share_236p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both use within-half adjacent return pairs
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Reversal energy depends on sign changes and signed pair structure. Campaign088 is invariant to every return sign and responds only to quadratic versus adjacent absolute-product variation.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_return_spectral_entropy_59f and intraday_return_variance_entropy_238m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: all describe how return variation is distributed
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Spectral and clock-bucket entropy measure frequency or allocation dispersion. Campaign088 is a fixed bipower residual share and has no spectrum, bin, or entropy calculation.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_upside_semivariance_share_239m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both normalize a component of total return variation
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Semivariance share depends on return sign. Campaign088 is sign-invariant and isolates discontinuity through adjacent absolute products.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_market_shock_magnitude_decoupling_238m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both can respond to isolated large returns
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Market shock decoupling requires a contemporaneous peer/market path. Campaign088 is entirely own-stock and has no benchmark, beta, residual, or cross-section.
